content_sections.heading: About District Magistrate Office, Gir Somnath
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Magistrate, Gir Somnath District, is on Veraval-Talala Road at Inaj in Veraval taluka. It issued this notice following Home Department circular No. HD/MIS/e-file/8/2026/3525/L-1 dated 17 July 2026, after the Government decided to form a panel to fill these posts. The panel is being prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, and the Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Work Rules-2026.

faq.question: Q1. Can an advocate with five years of practice apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice requires at least seven years of active practice as an advocate.

faq.question: Q2. Why are income tax returns needed?
faq.answer: Candidates must have paid income tax for at least three years before appointment, so the returns for the last three years must be enclosed. The form also asks for each year's income and tax paid.

faq.question: Q3. Can I send the application by email or courier?
faq.answer: No. The notice accepts the application form by speed post only. The office email address is not given as a way to apply.

faq.question: Q4. Is the posting date enough to meet the deadline?
faq.answer: No. The application must reach the office by 16 November 2026, so a form posted earlier but received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What must I carry to the interview?
faq.answer: Carry your original certificates. Travel and other costs of attending are your own.

faq.question: Q6. Until what age can an appointee serve?
faq.answer: An appointee can perform the duties up to a maximum age of 60 years.

faq.question: Q7. Do I have to disclose cases against me?
faq.answer: Yes. Item 14 of the form asks whether any police case has been registered against you or any case is pending in a court, with details.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply if I have already served as an Additional Public Prosecutor?
faq.answer: The form has a place for this. Item 16 asks for any past or present service in this role, with the period and dates.

faq.question: Q9. What proof of my practice should I attach?
faq.answer: Attach a copy of the certificate from the court where you began practising, along with a copy of your Sanad under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961.
